tools.name: inbox_post
tools.title: Leave a message in Inbox
tools.description: Leaves the user a message in Nightdrive Inbox, to look at when they have time: no notification, no sound, it waits until they read or archive it. For "done, have a look" with screenshots, a summary of what changed, a checklist to try, a build or a page to open; not for what needs them now (a notification or a question), for an answer to what they just asked in this session, nor for a thing to do by a date (a task). You are named as the sender by yourself (this session, its folder, account, and the Dashboard task number in its name). Markdown in body. attachments: files copied into the message (pictures show large, sound files play in the window), at most 10, 25 MB each, in home or /tmp and not hidden. actions: buttons, at most 8, each {kind, label} plus open: {path} (a file or folder), url: {url} (http/https), run: {command} or {argv}, and {dir} (default: this session's folder; the user sees the whole command and confirms it before it runs: never anything destructive), session: {session} (another session's id), task: {task}. This session and its task get their buttons by themselves. Returns the message's id: inbox_update adds to it later.

title.title: Title
title.description: What it is about, short: Cold Start: the new menus, have a look

attachments.title: Files
attachments.description: Paths of files to attach: absolute, or relative to this session's folder

task.title: Task
task.description: The Dashboard task it is about, when it isn't the one in this session's name

tools.name: inbox_update
tools.title: Add to a message in Inbox
tools.description: Adds to a message this session left in Inbox (its id from inbox_post or inbox_list): text at the end (append), a new body or title, more files, more buttons (as inbox_post takes them). It comes back to the top as unread, so use it for real news ("the build is ready"), not every small step. Only this session's own messages.

append.title: Add
append.description: Markdown added to the end, after a blank line

tools.notice: Added to the message in Inbox: {title}

tools.name: inbox_list
tools.title: Messages in Inbox
tools.description: The messages in Nightdrive Inbox, the newest first: id, title, at, updated, read (when, or null), from (kind claude: session, name, project, account; or app), task, archived, and how many files and buttons. mine: only this session's own (to find one to add to with inbox_update). unread: only those not read yet.
